prompt: A young cleric in white-and-gold vestments slumped dying against a fallen stone column, head lolling to one side, one hand pressed to a dark wound in her chest. No beam of light, no rays, no glowing motes. Cool blue dusk light falls through the broken pointed arches of a ruined chapel behind her, casting long shadows across cracked flagstones; her white robe catches the pale evening glow. A faint understated gold halo ring floats behind her head. Muted dusk palette of slate-blue, grey stone, and dim gold trim.

A young cleric in flowing white-and-gold vestments has collapsed onto her back at the moment of death on the polished marble floor of a cathedral, head fallen back, one arm sprawled open. No light beam, no rays, no glowing motes. Pale silver moonlight pours down through a shattered hole in the vaulted roof and through tall stained-glass windows, washing her robes in cold blue-white; deep shadow fills the nave between stone columns. A faint subtle gold halo ring rests behind her head. Cold moonlit palette of indigo, marble grey, and dull gold.

A faint subtle gold halo ring behind her head. Warm candlelit palette of amber, deep brown, ivory, and soft gold.
